title: Query family
description: One evaluation query family. A family has a canonical query plus exactly two INDEPENDENTLY written paraphrases (variants are not independent families, §21.3). It carries the declared scope, zero/one/many ground-truth intervals, atom/relation/logic labels, typed challengers, assessability and boundary labels, and track/logic ground truth. Test ground truth is human-derived and never from retriever proposals. Empty-set (cardinality=zero) families require full human review of the declared scope. Composes the other data/schemas/*.schema.json via $ref. See RAZIEL_Master_Execution_Plan_v1.3.md §21.3, §21.5.

pool.description: Provenance pool. staged, organizer, and external pools are kept strictly separate (plan 21.5). 'external' is third-party footage used ONLY as a generalization probe: its video is external, its labels are always our own human ledger. Third-party annotations are never imported as ground truth.

split.description: Assigned by scenario/session. All families of one scenario_id share one split; a session never straddles splits (enforced by eval/schema.py).

session_ids.description: Sessions this family draws ground truth from. Used for leakage checks.

capability_tags.description: Which supported capabilities this family exercises (for coverage reporting).

paraphrases.description: Exactly two paraphrases, each written independently by a different author (author_id must differ; enforced by eval/schema.py).

scope.description: Declared search scope. All claims are conditional on this scope and sampling policy.

labels.description: boundary is present for families with a target event to bound; it is omitted for empty-set (cardinality=zero) families.

ground_truth_source.description: Test truth is human-derived from the ledger. Retriever/auto proposals are prohibited as a source of test truth (§21.5).

empty_set_review.description: For cardinality=zero families, full human review of the declared scope is required and must be complete before the family is usable for test.
